## Development Setup

```bash
git clone git@github.com:Klauspind/InvestViden.git
cd InvestViden
```

## Project Structure

```
InvestViden/
├── src/investkb/          # Core application
├── examples/             # Demo data
├── schemas/              # JSON schemas
├── tests/               # Unit tests
├── config/              # Configuration files
├── inbox/               # Source documents (ignored)
├── data/                # SQLite databases (ignored)
├── output/              # Generated reports (ignored)
└── backups/             # Database backups (ignored)
```
